idea-plugin.name: Material Theme Preview
idea-plugin.description:
Material Theme Preview enhances the Kotlin coding experience by adding inline previews for MaterialTheme components in Jetpack Compose.

Features:
  • Color Previews: Instantly see the hex value and color swatch next to MaterialTheme.colorScheme references.
  • Typography Details: Display text size and line height hints for MaterialTheme.typography styles.
  • Shape Info: Show concise shape descriptions (e.g., corner radius) for MaterialTheme.shapes.
  • Color Gutter Icons: A color square appears in the gutter beside color references for quick visual scanning.
  • Smart Completion: Enhanced autocompletion for colorScheme, typography, and shapes properties, with color previews in the list.
  • Documentation Popups: Hover any MaterialTheme property to see detailed visual info.
Supported: IntelliJ IDEA 2024.2+ and Kotlin plugin (K1 & K2 mode).
Author: tungnk123
